'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Steve Harpster DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
